2.0.3: Added OTA Update support! You can now check for updates directly from the Queue Time Settings menu.
2.0.2: Vastly improved queue tracking: Queue Time now bypasses Spotify's 80-song display limit by intelligently calculating your true playlist context size and manually queued items to show the real total queue count and time!
2.0.1: Fixed duplicate header injection (no longer shows on 'Now playing').
2.0.0: Added Save to Playlist feature! You can now click the save icon directly in the Queue page to save your entire upcoming queue to a new playlist.
Added a Settings gear icon directly to the queue page so you can easily change between pill/text modes.
